brief: Return a sorted copy of a single-type array
description: Return a new array with the same entries as array, ordered using compareFunction. The array must have a single element data type (for example all integers or all strings); mixed or empty untyped arrays are not accepted. compareFunction is called with two entries and must return true when the first should sort before the second (boolean), not a numeric sort key.

parameters.description: Return true if value1 should be ordered before value2.
parameters.name: compareFunction

parameters.description: Array to sort. Must be single-type (all entries the same data type).
parameters.name: array

returns.description: A new array with the entries of array in sorted order.
